# notation usage target

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:notationUsageTarget`](gmeow-notationUsageTarget.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/notationUsageTarget>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/notation`](../../slices/notation.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The entity that uses the notation system — a language, lexical form, expression, work, or information object. Functional per relator: one target per [`NotationSystemUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NotationSystemUsage.md).

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:NotationSystemUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NotationSystemUsage.md) -> [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md); functional

Use [`gmeow:notationUsageTarget`](gmeow-notationUsageTarget.md) from [`gmeow:NotationSystemUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NotationSystemUsage.md) to [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use inside a [`gmeow:NotationSystemUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NotationSystemUsage.md) relator to name the single entity doing the using — the observed feature of this notation observation, subsumed under [`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting more than one target per relator (it is functional — mint a second usage instead) and avoid using it outside a [`NotationSystemUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NotationSystemUsage.md); for the unscoped language case use the flat [`gmeow:hasNotationSystem`](gmeow-hasNotationSystem.md).

### How to use

- Set exactly one [`gmeow:notationUsageTarget`](gmeow-notationUsageTarget.md) on each usage relator alongside its notation-system, role, and interval roles; the observation spine reads it as the observed feature.

- ex:u [`gmeow:notationUsageTarget`](gmeow-notationUsageTarget.md) ex:english.
